scopePolicy.mandatory: All required actions/features remain release blockers until meaningful exact-source acceptance passes
scopePolicy.optional: Plotting broader letters pages/image/PDF export and nonessential feedback retain conditional original scope; expose none as delivered
scopePolicy.pending: Test IDs on pending features are planned acceptance links; mapping does not imply implemented coverage; missing cases remain explicit blockers
scopePolicy.caseReadiness: missing_behavior_case entries have an executable workflow link but their specific assertion/gesture remains missing; release is blocked. ID linkage alone is not meaningful action coverage.
scopePolicy.support: supported layouts/themes/inputs describe target scope, not evidence each permutation currently works
scopePolicy.assertionLinkage: Meaningful baseline mappings include explicit test body trigger/assertion anchors validated by checker. planned_case links remain pending integration and missing_action_assertion links do not prove their actions. Static anchor validation is not independent review.
